title: A local image build leaves nothing a sibling's repin can wait on
foundBy: session agent, reviewing how local builds reach images (tasks/pin-on-local-builds.md, section 7)

evidence.verified: TestBuildRecordsItsImageForASiblingsRepin, TestBuildCommitsItsImageRecordInARepositoryStore and TestBuildRecordsNoImageSiblingsMayNotPin pass. For real, `cs-sandbox build` and `cs-sandbox build --slim` at 3b3e213 wrote sandbox.json and sandbox-slim.json under images/sandbox/<commit>/ in the store. GitHub CI's `ci` passed on 3b3e213, once the nested sandbox smoke job was run again: its microVM had stopped answering.

resolution: An image `build` makes of a commit the store records is recorded there, and committed where the store is a git repository (SPEC R168). The `make ci` here records its build awaiting both images, so a sibling's repin waits for them.
details: CI's status file lists a sandbox commit only once both of its images are published. `make ci` records a local build of sandbox with no word of images, and `cs-sandbox build` writes nothing to the build store once it has made one. So campaign's `make repin` cannot tell a local sandbox build that has its images from one that has none.
